title: D2 D2Result envelope spec
description: Schema for contracts/d2result-envelope/d2result-envelope.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of JSON property names for the D2Result Shape B wire envelope (the BFF gateway response shape that every frontend reads). D2.Shared.Result.Envelope.SourceGen emits D2ResultEnvelopeFieldNames into D2.Shared.Result; tools/ts-codegen emits the same catalog into @d2/result. Both sides reference the codegen-emitted constants for the wire property names — the .NET D2Result properties carry [JsonPropertyName(D2ResultEnvelopeFieldNames.*)] attributes, and the TS gateway parser reads via the same camelCase constants. Cross-language wire drift is structurally impossible.

fields.description: Field-name entries for the D2Result envelope wire shape.

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the catalog.

value.description: Wire-format JSON property name — camelCase. Must be unique across the catalog.
